text: Then came the biggest party of the year, the summer party basketball game. Everybody showed up in party hats. When I walked onto the court, everybody laughed. Who's the kid in the beanie? Then I got the ball. Fifty points all by myself. The music stopped. The whole crowd went silent. Kevin walked up to me and asked, "When did you get so good?" I told him the truth: while you were out partying, the next night...
